text:
Maya Chen: heads-up — opened a PR to tidy the localization matrix and add the new ap-sg region entries. also spotted an edge case in the data residency notes for Private deployments that needs clearer wording. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842

Leo Park: thanks — saw the PR. I pushed an updated SDK snippet for the region header but left a TODO for the legacy endpoint guidance. can someone confirm the header name we want to document: `X-Redwood-Region` or `Redwood-Region`?

Samir Patel: we standardized on `X-Redwood-Region` last quarter for server-side SDKs, but older client guides used `Redwood-Region`. we should mention both and recommend the `X-` prefixed header for new integrations.

Maya Chen: agree. can we add a small migration note for customers still using the old header? something like: "If your client sets `Redwood-Region`, update to `X-Redwood-Region` to ensure compatibility with load-balancers and legacy proxies."

Leo Park: added a short migration section in the PR, but i kept it terse. @Natalie Gomez can you expand with a one-line example for curl + node? i want to keep the doc page scannable.

Natalie Gomez: taking it. adding two micro-examples — curl + node fetch. also will flag the broken link to the GDPR footnote (the anchor changed).

Natalie Gomez: snippet drafts:

```bash
# curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: ap-sg-1" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

```js
// node example (fetch)
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`,
    'X-Redwood-Region': 'ap-sg-1',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({prompt: 'hi'})
})
```
text_addendum:
docs-bot: deploy-preview for PR #842 published: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/842 — please review the migration note and the GDPR footnote link fix. :eyes:

Maya Chen: QA checklist — (1) confirm header name and examples render in both desktop and mobile layouts, (2) update matrix CSV row for ap-sg-1, (3) add footnote anchor redirect for GDPR.

Samir Patel: I'll take the CSV row and footnote redirect. leaving a comment on the PR for the anchor change. :white_check_mark:

Leo Park: i fixed a minor formatting issue in the SDK snippet (code fence). left a suggestion to shorten the migration sentence.

Natalie Gomez: pushed the example commit and fixed the broken anchor. preview looks fine on mobile. changed phrase to: "If you previously set `Redwood-Region`, migrate to `X-Redwood-Region` to avoid routing issues."

Maya Chen: perfect. if no objections i'll merge after CI passes. anyone want to double-check wording for the Private deployment data residency blurb?

Samir Patel: quick read — looks accurate. small nit: call out KMS/HSM only if it's relevant to residency (left a comment).

Leo Park: CI green. merging in 5.

Natalie Gomez: thx all! will follow up with a small tweet for docs release notes and add an internal cross-ref in the onboarding checklist.

Maya Chen: thanks team. closing thread after merge. :rocket:
